Name: Irradiator
Author: justastranger
TagLine: Induced radioactivity, also called artificial radioactivity or man-made radioactivity, is the process of using radiation to make a previously stable material radioactive.
Description:
Adds a machine that converts regular ore into radioactive ore.
Requires Dynamic Game Assets.

Recipe can be bought from Robin for 500,000 gold.
You need 5 radioactive bars, 10 iridium bars, 5 batteries, and 1 prismatic shard to create each machine.
Each operation requires a battery as fuel.
The conversion ratio depends on which ore you use but always produce one radioactive ore per operation.
You can use 25 copper, 10 iron, 5 gold, or 2 iridium ore.

Known issues: The recipe looks incorrect in the buy menu. This is a just a visual bug from DGA.
Sometimes the recipe, alongside other DGA recipes, don't appear in the crafting menu. You might need to use a new save if this occurs. Alternatively, I've had success loading a new save, going back to the main menu, then loading the save I actually want to play. Which needs to be repeated each time you launch the game.

Downloads.Description: Using the magic of induced radioactivity you can turn normal, everyday ores into radioactive ores.
